cards.headline: Your mail, in focus.
cards.sub: A calm mail app for Android, with serious tools underneath.

cards.headline: What if the mail app on your phone understood this?
There is no Loupe cloud.
cards.sub: Your phone talks to your mail server. Nobody sits in between.

cards.headline: Free. Open source. Private by design.
cards.sub: Loupe lands on 20 October.

cards.headline: Meet Loupe.
cards.sub: Simple on the surface. Powerful underneath. Free and open source.

cards.headline: One calm inbox.
cards.sub: Every account together, with gestures you already know.

cards.headline: Newsletters, rebuilt for your hand.
cards.sub: Readable mode fits any HTML mail to the screen.

cards.headline: Search like you mean it.
cards.sub: Fields, groups, dates, negation. Phone first, server after.

cards.headline: Phishing, explained.
cards.sub: Loupe says why a message looks wrong, in plain words.

cards.headline: No servers. No tracking. No ads.
cards.sub: Download free at loupe.mx. Pay what you want, if you like it.

cards.headline: Stop pinching newsletters.
cards.sub: Real text sizes, footers as fine print, photos as a carousel.

cards.kicker: Your server, the source of truth
cards.headline: Rules as Sieve. Snooze as a folder.
cards.sub: Everything that outlives your phone lives on your mail server.

cards.headline: 11 packages. 1,900+ tests. 0 trackers.
cards.sub: Every line is on GitHub under the MPL-2.0.

cards.headline: Thank you.
cards.sub: For every download, bug report, star and kind word. Here's what's next.

cards.headline: How do you snooze mail without a server?
cards.sub: Most apps snooze on their own servers. Loupe has none.

cards.headline: The message moves to a Snoozed folder.
cards.sub: On your mail server, where every client can see it.

cards.headline: A keyword says when it wakes up.
cards.sub: Stored on the message itself, in UTC minutes.

cards.headline: Any device can wake it.
cards.sub: Switch phones or clients: nothing is trapped. The convention is documented on GitHub.

cards.headline: "This looks like phishing", and why.
cards.sub: Look-alike domains and familiar names from new addresses, checked on your phone.

cards.headline: Unread this week, minus the newsletters
Save a search. Find it on every device.
cards.sub: Stored on your own mail server, not in our cloud. We don't have one.

cards.headline: Big, old attachments, ready to clean up
cards.sub: Save it as a Smart Mailbox and tidy up once a month.

cards.headline: Which newsletters do you never read?
cards.sub: Loupe counts on your phone, then unsubscribes in one tap.

cards.headline: OpenPGP that just works.
cards.sub: Autocrypt, Thunderbird-compatible keys, and a hidden subject line.

cards.headline: Use the certificate your company already gave you.
cards.sub: Loupe signs and decrypts with certificates installed on your Android device.

cards.headline: Write a rule like a search.
cards.sub: Run it on the phone, or on your server as Sieve.

cards.headline: Accept, Maybe, Decline. Right there.
cards.sub: With both time zones when they differ.

cards.headline: Three panes and a command palette.
cards.sub: Ctrl+K for everything.

cards.headline: Review patches on the train.
cards.sub: Diffs in colour, lists as forum threads, mute what's noisy.

cards.headline: True black, and readable.
cards.sub: Message colours fixed for dark backgrounds.
